title: staleBuild
responsibility: Warns when a dist entry predates files in the checkout source trees; packaged or unreadable source trees produce no warning.

inputs.name: staleBuild.entry
inputs.description: Path to the entry file being considered for execution.

outputs.name: staleBuild
outputs.description: A rebuild warning when an entry under dist is older than a file under the checkout’s src or crates tree; undefined for other paths or when no newer source can be inspected.
